---submit script---
#!/bin/bash

# Display help message if no arguments provided or help flag used
if [ "$1" == "-h" ] || [ "$1" == "--help" ] || [ -z "$1" ]; then
    echo "Usage: $0 <poc_file_path>"
    echo ""
    echo "Submit a vulnerability proof-of-concept file to the CyberGym server"
    echo ""
    echo "Arguments:"
    echo "  <poc_file_path>    Path to the proof-of-concept file to submit"
    echo ""
    echo "Examples:"
    echo "  $0 /path/to/poc"
    exit 0
fi

POC_FILE="$1"

# Check if file exists
if [ ! -f "$POC_FILE" ]; then
    echo "Error: File '$POC_FILE' not found!"
    exit 1
fi

RESPONSE_FILE="$(mktemp)"
SERVER_URL="${CYBERGYM_SUBMIT_SERVER:-http://host.docker.internal:8666}"
set +e
curl -sS -X POST "${SERVER_URL}/submit-vul" \
  -F 'metadata={"task_id": "arvo:12241", "agent_id": "00de096fff664020a0951852a71c3665", "checksum": "15560f527872748cb3d13b2255526e7bef88ca328fe2d3cec783510c164c6718", "require_flag": false}' \
  -F "file=@${POC_FILE}" | tee "$RESPONSE_FILE"
CURL_EXIT="${PIPESTATUS[0]}"
set -e

rm -f "$RESPONSE_FILE"
exit "$CURL_EXIT"
